The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galtea/Legends|Galtea]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], had one '''moon'''. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] allied to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] attacked the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' near Galtea. The Imperial force used the moon to screen their approach to the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]].
